topic: On Big Mom's sixth birthday, Mother Carmel and every orphan in the Sheep's House vanished without a word while she was eating her croquembouche
title: Mother Carmel Vanished On Her Birthday
description: Big Mom turned six, and the Sheep's House threw her a birthday party with a massive croquembouche made entirely of semla. She ate it, happy and oblivious. When she looked up, Carmel and every single orphan were simply gone. No goodbye. No explanation. Just an empty house.
comment: Did Mother Carmel plan to disappear on that exact birthday, or was the timing just cruel coincidence?

lines.text: The Sheep's House threw a sixth birthday party for Linlin with a massive croquembouche made entirely of semla.

shot.fallback: festive birthday party with towering dessert

lines.text: She ate the entire thing in one sitting, completely happy and oblivious to everything happening around her.

shot.fallback: joyful child lost in a treat

lines.text: When she finally looked up, Mother Carmel and every single orphan in that house were simply gone.

shot.fallback: empty room where people had just been

lines.text: Not even the croquembouche plates were cleared. Just an entire life, gone, mid-celebration, without a trace.
No goodbye. No real explanation. Just an empty house and a six-year-old left completely alone.

shot.fallback: solitary child in an abandoned space

lines.text: Big Mom still screams that same question at every tea party decades later: where did Mother Carmel go?

shot.search: Big Mom screams tea party question
shot.fallback: towering empress screaming at empty space

lines.text: She carries that moment in a portrait she never lets go of, the one person who ever chose her.

shot.search: Big Mom portrait Carmel never lets go
shot.fallback: powerful woman keeping a fragile memento

lines.text: The woman in that portrait vanished on her birthday and left a six-year-old the only answer...
